words.example: Please bring the heads-up to the morning huddle.
words.exampleZh: 早碰头时请带上这个事先提醒。

words.example: The green light still needs a decision today.
words.exampleZh: 这个放行批准今天还得拍个板。

words.example: We talked about the red flag with the department head.
words.exampleZh: 我们和科主任谈了这个警示信号。

words.example: The gray area still needs a decision today.
words.exampleZh: 这个模糊地带今天还得拍个板。

words.example: I put the chain of command on the shared drive.
words.exampleZh: 我把汇报链条放到了共享盘。

words.example: Please test the least privilege on the backup environment first.
words.exampleZh: 请先在备用环境测试这个最小权限。

words.example: The ward asked us to check the privileged access.
words.exampleZh: 病区让我们看一下这个特权访问。

words.example: The ward asked us to check the session timeout.
words.exampleZh: 病区让我们看一下这个会话超时。

words.example: Do not touch the idle timeout during outpatient hours.
words.exampleZh: 门诊时段不要动这个空闲超时。

words.example: We will verify the account expiry after the night batch.
words.exampleZh: 夜批结束后我们再核对这个账号到期。
